description: Source file implementing hardware utility functions for STM32F7 microcontroller, including stack management, fault handling, SPI initialization, BOR (Brown-Out Reset) configuration, and fault register capture for debugging.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates remaining stack space depending on context and compiler, used for debugging stack usage.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware, resets cycle counter, sets Brown-Out Reset level.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Captures CPU register states from stack for postmortem debugging.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handles hard fault exceptions, captures fault info, and may break into debugger.

methods.name: BOR_Get
methods.description: Reads current Brown-Out Reset level from flash option bytes.

methods.name: BOR_Set
methods.description: Sets Brown-Out Reset level in flash option bytes.

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects CAN device based on RX and TX pins.
